title: Add "lock screen when paired device is out of range" feature to bluedevil.
line: A Bluetooth device's settings page has a new "Lock screen when disconnected" switch, so walking away with your phone locks the screen.
explanation: Bluedevil had no proximity lock like KBlueLock had: nothing reacted when a paired device went out of range. The new per-device switch on the KCM's device page stores the device's address in bluedevilglobalrc (lockScreenDevices), and bluedevil's kded calls org.freedesktop.ScreenSaver.Lock when one of those devices disconnects. It waits 2 seconds first and does nothing if the device came back, the adapter was powered off or Bluetooth was blocked in the meantime, or the system is going to sleep, so turning Bluetooth off or a short drop never locks.

commits.message:
kcm, kded: add an option to lock the screen when a device disconnects

There was no way to lock the screen automatically when walking away
with a paired phone or watch. The device page now has a switch for it,
and the daemon locks the screen when that device goes out of range.

BUG: 266829

media.caption: Master: a paired phone's settings page has no option to lock the screen
Master: the phone goes out of range and disconnects, the session stays unlocked
Patched: new "Lock screen when disconnected" switch on the device page, turned on
Patched: the phone goes out of range and disconnects, the screen locks two seconds later
